page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet. Top right, the e-rara logo. Centre, the e-rara web address, the digitiser's title block (title, author, place and year, library, persistent link). Below a rule, the multilingual platform description (German, English, French, Italian). Below a second rule, the terms-of-use notices (German, English, French, Italian). Bottom right, the Visual Library logo.
page.notes: No text of the printed book appears on this scan. The title block, logos, platform description and terms of use are the digitiser's own material and are left out as instructed. The title of the work, as given on the cover sheet, is "Disputatio theologica textualis ex Ioh. 3. v. 5 de regeneratione" by Johannes Niklaus, [Bernae], 1674. It is not printed text from this page and is not transcribed.
